title: Operator Workflow Trace Recording
claim: FP-MCP-266 implemented append-only operator workflow trace recording and read-only trace summarization in the MCP bridge without invoking live OpenCode actions.
summary: Added MCP bridge support for OPERATOR_WORKFLOW_TRACE_V1. The writer records intended action versus actual tool call, phase, step index, approval literal, workflow advancement, deviation taxonomy, side effects, notes, recovery action, and safety boundaries under runs/<packetId>/operator-workflow-traces/. The summarizer reads trace artifacts, counts deviations and side effects, lists tool mismatches, and recommends review focus. Bridge build passed and pnpm test passed after removing hardcoded packet-id examples.
caveats: The new tools were implemented and committed in the MCP bridge, but this checkpoint does not prove post-reload ChatGPT UI surfacing of the new tools.
A preceding OPERATOR telemetry recovery commit c96cd8f recorded control-plane mismatches observed during this session before implementation continued.
